top_candidate: LIDAR-01 — slope-aware scarp templates plus scale-persistent Steger/Frangi line evidence; ranked, not implemented or validated
hypothesis: Method-faithful scarp-template fits and signed, scale-persistent ridge/valley evidence from native-resolution bare-earth LiDAR may preserve geomorphic scarp signatures omitted from the public catalogue and diluted by 100 m aggregation. This remains untested; no DTI improvement is measured.
mechanism: A fault scarp can retain a cross-profile step/curvature shape, amplitude, orientation, and diffusion-related morphologic age, while coherent ridge/valley evidence persists along strike across nearby physical scales. Combining independent measurements may distinguish scarps from isolated edges, but terrace risers, natural channel banks, landslide headscarps, shorelines, roads/canals, and DEM seams can mimic the same signals.
named_non_fault_mimic: Fluvial terrace riser; natural channel-bank lines and landslide headscarps are mandatory additional controls.
